scripts.name: Install Cirrus
scripts.command: xcrun cc --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools; cargo xtask install

scripts.name: Run (dev)
scripts.command: xcrun cc --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools; cargo run -p cirrus
